title: Decoding the role of cancer-associated fibroblasts in cisplatin resistance of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
snippet: Cisplatin remains the primary chemotherapy drug for the treatment of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). However, acquired resistance significantly limits its clinical application, contributing to treatment failure and a poor patient prognosis.
